PlayerAccount.title: PlayerAccount
PlayerAccount.description: Cloud-synced player account and campaign progression profile on the Firebase Spark plan.

userId.description: The authenticated Firebase Auth UID owning this account.

displayName.description: Player's chosen doodle nickname or Gmail display name (1 to 50 chars).

email.description: Optional Gmail address associated with the account (up to 150 chars).

authMethod.description: How the account profile was registered ('gmail' or 'account').

perfectCount.description: Total number of flawless rounds completed.

completedLevelsCount.description: Total number of campaign levels completed (0 to 1000).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the account was first created (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the account was last synced (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

/players/{userId}.description: Per-user cloud profile and game progression document keyed by Firebase Auth UID.
